rule: Failure signatures prioritize investigation; they do not prove cause. Confirm the earliest failing layer with ORIGINAL_V1_DEFORMATION_DIAGNOSIS_TREE.json before editing.

questions: Is too broad a surface owned by one moving bone?
Does the surface already fail with correctives disabled?
Does topology bridge attachment sides with insufficient support?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: add a corrective that merely pushes the membrane inward

questions: Does the trench appear only when a corrective activates?
Is there an abrupt weight ownership seam?
Does edge flow support smooth compression?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: fill the pit with an unrelated bulge

questions: Are multiple attachment sides represented?
Is Preserve Volume/DQ amplifying bulge?
Is one corrective uniformly inflating the region?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: scale the entire region to look better at one endpoint

questions: Do proximal/distal influences cross smoothly?
Does the topology have enough rings/support?
Does skinning formulation collapse blended rotations?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: blur weights outside the declared repair zone

questions: Are twist helper bones distributing rotation?
Is one segment carrying too much axial rotation?
Does mode change reduce/increase the artifact under controlled A/B?
Does the crease persist outside compression?
Are crease vertices tied too sharply to one bone?
Does topology force one circumferential fold?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: bake a permanent crease into neutral geometry

questions: Where does volume first diverge in dense samples?
Does weights-only already lose the attachment bridge?
Does corrective contribution move mass rather than refine it?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: compensate one disappearing area by inflating another

questions: Which dense sample has largest second difference?
Do shape-key values change continuously?
Does weights-only remain smooth?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: add another endpoint key without fixing interpolation

questions: Do identical joint states produce identical evaluated surface outbound and return?
Is a driver accumulating state?
Is any dynamic layer failing to settle/reset?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: reset the mesh manually only at neutral

questions: Is skeletal contact target correct?
Is load propagated through proximal chain?
Is local soft tissue response compensating for wrong contact?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: move tissue through the object to make contact look stable

questions: Are rig transforms mirrored?
Are weights/topology intended to be symmetric?
Do corrective drivers/keys have matched data?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: accept unexplained asymmetry because one side looks good

symptoms: scapula/femur visible as rigid shell movement
questions: Does human evidence show skin sliding relative to bone?
Are bridge vertices blended across appropriate anchors?
Is surface deformation distributed spatially?
signatures.forbidden_shortcut: increase bone ownership because marker/bone motion appears numerically clean
